description.name: Entry
description.text:
Tactical Awoken Mode & +500 ATK to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Earth Ability Boost, Triplecast Earth, Unlimited Earth Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Earth Abilities, Earth Ability Damage +30% & 20% DEF/RES Pierce to Earth Abilities; Ends after using 8 Earth abilities
TP Max: AOE Earth/NE physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text:
Single-target Earth/NE piercing physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & 30% DEF/RES Pierce to Earth Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold with at least Lv.0/2 En-Earth
WS Blue: Lv.2 En-Earth Stack to user
WS Gold: During Tactical Awoken Mode, Earth Ability Damage +50% & chases an Earth ability with Quick ATB 2 (max 1 chase) to user
